complete_model: Normalized-sine law with e=1023/1024, w=1/1024, beta=1, held capacities one. tau=e*t; both rows transform. No forcing or phase probes.
preparation: Original C9 nominal forms k*(2046/9)*(355/113)^2*(j-4), initially phase-flat; donor k=1 or 2, held-out receiver k=2. Each original form/phase residual is bounded by 1e-10 with separate exact zero sums. Receiver common phase origin 1/1000 is declared from initial preparation; donor origin 0. Form origins 0. Both original sixteen-dimensional relative families remain admitted.
schedule: Acquire at tau=100, continue both isolated actual flows unprobed for D=10^13, attach one unit bridge at tau_c=100+D with no state reset, then hold support. No further events.
observation: Actual held-out receiver class-two form at global node 13 at tau_c+1/100; donor-two minus donor-one contrast. Independent additive readout error <=1e-30 in each record.

retained_reduction.component_state: Five signed forms and five real target-phase deviations, retaining both component origins; common form and phase origins are not quotiented.
retained_reduction.component_parameters: Class index k in {1,2}; internal cosine cos(2*pi*k/9), gamma=1/(1023*pi), internal C9 mobility with the actual degree-three port. Parameters are derived independently of recipient responses and unchanged between recipient classes.
retained_reduction.composition: Exact nonlinear sine of the relative port phases and linear port form exchange; internal sine field alone is linearized about the formed twist.
retained_reduction.discarded_information: Four reflection-odd modes per channel per component are omitted from retained state. Their initial uncertainty and nonlinear generation are covered by explicit full-space error estimates; no exact invariant nonlinear quotient is claimed.

prediction.error_criterion: Total prediction error E must be strictly less than one quarter of the final outward recorded_contrast_bounds.lo, itself positive. This interval is built from the interval enclosure of the exact leading expression P plus [-E,E]. E includes semigroup tail, reduced nonlinear finite-response remainder, twice the lifted surrogate/full discrepancy, actual-source uncertainty and both readout errors. A positive exact fractional margin whose outward lower endpoint is zero does not certify.

controls: Exact projection and lift identify five reflection-even spatial modes; the odd internal nonlinear residual is retained in the error proof.
The unchanged component matrices support recipient classes one and two; per-case response derivatives retain receiver-class dependence.
The reduced-matrix fourth contrast coefficient is derived directly; lower donor contrasts vanish under a shared recipient.
Zero phase offset and disconnected controls retain their separate scope; no contact or hidden-state selection law is inferred.

method.name: reflection_even_ports_exact_bridge_correlated_interval_v1
method.joined_identity: Full original eighteen-node law, gap >=2/81, cosine >=1/20, radius1/12; no surrogate storage substitution.
method.finite_response: Derivatives through fourth order from the reduced matrices, common-semigroup tail and full nonlinear bridge remainder.
method.ideal_surrogate_to_full_per_case: 8*gamma^5*sin(phi)^2*h^5 / (45*(1-3*h)) upper bound, using upper absolute sine and gamma bounds.
method.generic_forecast: Not used. The row evaluator is a detached surrogate field, not a trajectory solver or an increased generic forecast work cap.

stopping_rule: Pass only if fresh formation, both actual unprobed handoffs, full joined identity, event-work allowance, strict final outward actual recorded contrast lower bound >1e-25, and a positive outward lower bound for error_fraction*recorded_contrast_bounds.lo-E all hold. Preserve an unavailable or negative result without tuning protocol primitives, coefficients, precision or thresholds.

runtime.backend: Python exact Fraction plus fixed outward dyadic128; exact squared decay bounds below interval grid
runtime.seed_scope: No random input or trajectory samples; pressure supplied analytically by complete law, no held-pressure approximation.

scope: One prospective transfer of a rigorously bounded smaller constituent model under supplied law, source preparation, clock, observation and contact. No autonomous constituent/contact selection, exact nonlinear closure, minimality, practical sensing or physical identification.
